resources.string: Leaves YouTube Shorts and the Instagram Reels tab as soon as they open. Reads view ids in those two apps only. It does not read text, and it has no internet access.

Focus Guard needs this to notice when Shorts or Reels open. If Android says \"Restricted setting\", tap \"Allow restricted\", open the ⋮ menu, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then come back and turn it on.
Stops Android from shutting the blocker down in the background.
Switch Autostart on for Focus Guard so it comes back after a restart. This cannot be checked from here.
Choose \"No restrictions\" for Focus Guard. This cannot be checked from here.
That settings page is not available on this phone. Find Focus Guard in the Settings app.
